note: No station-to-station fare chart in this source. Treat any fare amounts as sample data.

rules.children_free: Two children under 3 ft free with one adult
rules.token_csc_phase1_only: Token/GMRC card valid only within Phase 1 stations; not for travel between Phase 1 and Phase 2
rules.digital_qr_failure: Phone hang, loss, battery failure, switched-off device or network issue is treated as ticketless travel
rules.refund: Only unused QR paper ticket/token within 30 min at issuing station; digital QR and group QR non-refundable
